faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager post is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate to be eligible for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for applicants is 18 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline by sending the application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Maharashtra Forest Department.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is कक्ष-3/फाऊंडेशन/2026-27/714.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager post is contractual.
